text: dsh-composer-launcher 是面向 DSH 网页端的输入框启动器，在输入框旁提供统一菜单，并把所选内容显示为原生引用芯片。它可添加文件与文件夹、会话、计划与目标、斜杠命令、技能、MCP 服务和已安装插件；可选浏览器扩展把当前标签页送入菜单。适合需要快速为对话附加上下文的 DSH 用户，浏览器标签同步需加载扩展。

dsh-composer-launcher adds a menu beside the DSH web composer. Users can attach files, chats, commands, skills, MCP servers, plugins, and reference chips. An optional browser extension supplies open tabs.

dsh-composer-launcher 的功能「输入框添加菜单」：在输入框左侧打开分组菜单，选择文件、会话、命令、技能、MCP 服务或插件，并将选项加入上下文。
dsh-composer-launcher 的功能「会话引用栏」：把已选引用作为输入框上方的芯片展示，可逐项移除；芯片状态按会话区分。
dsh-composer-launcher 的功能「浏览器标签桥接」：扩展在标签变化时推送标题与网址到本机桥接服务，让当前浏览页面可从菜单选择。
dsh-composer-launcher 的功能「启动器设置」：设置卡可控制菜单行显隐、常用插件展示模式与数量，并配置标签页显示数量。
dsh-composer-launcher 的标签扩展会把打开标签的标题和网址发送到本机回环地址 127.0.0.1:43130；标签页同步需安装并启用扩展。
dsh-composer-launcher 的插件声明仅兼容 DSH 0.1.5 rc.2 至 0.2.0 之前版本；安装前需确认宿主版本符合范围。

dsh-composer-launcher README · What this is：By default the `+` button left of the composer opens a file picker. Everything else you may want to point the model at — a browser tab you are looking at, an earlier conversation, a skill, an MCP server, one of the plugins installed on this machine — has to be typed by hand, or referenced with `@`.

`dsh-composer-launcher` replaces that button with a **three-group menu**:

dsh-composer-launcher README · What this is：| Group | What is in it |
|---|---|
| **Add** | files and folders, earlier chats, plan mode, goal mode |
| **Capabilities** | slash commands, skills, MCP servers |
| **Common plugins** | one row per installed plugin, plus an "all plugins" row |

What you pick does not get pasted in as text. It becomes a **reference chip** on a rail above the input box — the same native chip kind the host already renders for `@` references — and only turns into message text when you actually send.

dsh-composer-launcher README · What this is：There is also an **optional browser extension** (`DSH Tab Bridge`) which pushes your real browser's tabs to the plugin over a loopback HTTP bridge, so the Tabs row lists the pages you genuinely have open rather than a throwaway debug instance.

---

dsh-composer-launcher README · 1. The `+` menu (three groups)：- **Add** — *Files and folders* (the host's own picker, multi-select, drag-and-drop; falls back to `@` references when the host exposes no folder picker), *Chats* (via `remote.sessionReferenceResolver`; chats only, no files), *Plan*, *Goal*.
- **Capabilities** — *Commands* (whatever the host's slash-command service offers), *Skills* (read live with `ctx.remote.skills.list({ sessionId })`), *MCP* (needs the host's `remote.mcpManager`).
- **Common plugins** — one row per plugin returned by `ctx.remote.pluginInventory.list()`. That list is read from the host on every load, so installing, removing or disabling a plugin is reflected immediately and there is no cache to keep in sync. Three modes decide which rows appear: `pinned`, `frequent`, `mixed` (see [Settings](#settings)).
dsh-composer-launcher README · 1. The `+` menu (three groups)：Every row can be switched off individually from the settings card.

dsh-composer-launcher README · 2. Reference chips：Picked items land on a rail **above** the input box (`conversation.input.dock`). A chip is `{ label, kind, icon }` plus an optional `url`, where `kind` is one of `web`, `plugin`, `skill`, `mcp`. Clicking the `×` removes it.

Two properties are worth naming, because both were bugs before they were features:

dsh-composer-launcher README · 2. Reference chips：- **A web chip keeps its address.** A page title with no URL is useless to whoever reads the message — the chip carries the URL and the payload includes it.
- **A session reference stays a chip.** Writing a reference back through the plain-text draft API silently downgrades it to body text; the plugin renders it as a chip instead and never round-trips it through the text editor.

Chips are **per session**, so two chat tabs never share a rail.

dsh-composer-launcher README · 2. Reference chips：On send, each chip is serialised into the message with a short marker, so the model can tell a referenced page from an attached file:

| Chip kind | Marker |
|---|---|
| web page | `【参考网页】<title> — <url>` |
| plugin | `【使用插件】<name>` |
| skill | `【技能】<name>` |
| MCP server | `【MCP】<name>` |

> These markers are literal and stay in Chinese in both interface languages. They are part of the text the **model** reads, not interface copy — translating them would change what the model sees.

dsh-composer-launcher README · 3. Settings card：Registered on the `settings.plugin.item` slot as a card titled **Launcher** — 「启动器」 in the Chinese interface. It is collapsed the first time you open it and remembers that choice. All twelve fields are listed under [Settings](#settings).

dsh-composer-launcher README · 4. Debug browser (fallback)：The Tabs row can also read tabs over a remote-debugging port from a Chromium process it starts itself. That is what **Launch debug browser** does — and when the extension is staged, the same call attaches it with `--load-extension` and then verifies through the debugging port that it really mounted, so this route needs no manual step at all (see [The browser extension](#the-browser-extension)). It stays a fallback rather than the primary path because it only ever sees that one throwaway-profile instance, never the browser you already have open.

dsh-composer-launcher README · 5. Loopback bridge：The host half owns a small HTTP bridge on `127.0.0.1:43130` (override: `DSH_LAUNCHER_BRIDGE_PORT`) so the extension can push tabs into it. It binds loopback only, yields politely if an older instance already holds the port, and is used for nothing else.

dsh-composer-launcher README · The browser extension：The plugin works without it — the Tabs row simply says the extension is not installed and points at the button. With it, the row lists the tabs of your **everyday browser**.

dsh-composer-launcher README · Three ways to get it loaded：Chromium will not let anything silently sideload an extension into the browser you use every day. That is a browser security rule with no plugin-side workaround, so the goal is a different one: make every *remaining* step either automatic or one click.

|---|---|---|
| **A — a browser this plugin starts** | The plugin spawns a separate Chromium process with `--load-extension` pointing at the staged copy, then **verifies through the debugging port that the extension really mounted** | none |
| **B — your everyday browser** | The Tabs row offers *Open the extensions page* and *Copy the extension path*, so loading it once is a paste and a "Load unpacked" | one time, ~20 seconds |
| **C — managed machines** | Chromium enterprise policy (`ExtensionSettings` / `ExtensionInstallForcelist`) pointing at a self-hosted, signed CRX plus an HTTPS update manifest | admin rights; **not shipped here** |

text: dsh-composer-launcher README · Three ways to get it loaded：**Route A is verified, not assumed.** After launching, the plugin asks the debugging port for its raw target list and looks for *this* extension's own worker (`chrome-extension://<id>/background.js`) rather than "some extension" — every Chromium ships several of its own. Chromium reports no error when `--load-extension` is ignored, so a launch on its own proves nothing.
section: Three ways to get it loaded

text: dsh-composer-launcher README · Three ways to get it loaded：If our worker is missing, the plugin retries once on a clean profile `~/.dsh-edge-agent-ext` and says so in the `healed` and `note` fields of its answer. That is not defensive padding: a profile that was ever opened *without* the command-line switches can stop honouring them, and the plugin's default profile `~/.dsh-edge-agent` does exactly that on some machines. If both attempts fail, `extensionLoaded` comes back `false` and the Tabs row falls back to reading tabs over the debugging port — the plugin never claims a step it did not actually complete.

text:
dsh-composer-launcher README · How it works：It does not poll. The extension **pushes**:

| Trigger | Action |
|---|---|
| `tabs.onCreated` / `onUpdated` / `onRemoved` / `onActivated` / `onMoved` / `onAttached` / `onDetached` | push immediately |
| a 1-minute `alarms` heartbeat | push |
| browser startup, install, update | push |

dsh-composer-launcher README · How it works：Each push is a `POST` to `http://127.0.0.1:43130/composer-launcher/tabs` with `{ tabs: [...] }`. A failed push is swallowed, never thrown — the bridge is allowed to be down, and the extension must not spam console errors while it is.

dsh-composer-launcher README · How it works：The host keeps the last push for **65 seconds** (`PUSH_TTL_MS`), deliberately longer than the 1-minute heartbeat, so one slow tick cannot make the row flicker to empty. An **empty** push is ignored rather than obeyed (`ignored: 'empty-push-kept-previous'`), because a browser that momentarily reports nothing must not wipe the list.

dsh-composer-launcher README · How it works：Pushed fields are `{ id, title, url, host, favIconUrl, browser }`. Internal pages are filtered before sending: `chrome:`, `edge:`, `brave:`, `opera:`, `vivaldi:`, `about:`, `devtools:`, `chrome-extension:`, `extension:`, `moz-extension:`.

The popup shows the connection state, lets you edit the port, and has a **Save and push now** button for when you do not want to wait for the next heartbeat.
dsh-composer-launcher README · Which browsers：The extension is Manifest V3 and talks to `globalThis.browser ?? globalThis.chrome`, so it loads in every Chromium browser as well as Firefox.

dsh-composer-launcher README · Which browsers：| Browser | Extensions page | Loading |
|---|---|---|
| Microsoft Edge | `edge://extensions` | Load unpacked |
| Google Chrome | `chrome://extensions` | Load unpacked |
| Brave | `brave://extensions` | Load unpacked |
| Vivaldi | `vivaldi://extensions` | Load unpacked |
| Opera | `opera://extensions` | Load unpacked |
| Arc | `arc://extensions` | Load unpacked |
| 360 极速浏览器 | `chrome://extensions` | Load unpacked |
| QQ 浏览器 | `chrome://extensions` | Load unpacked |
| Firefox | `about:debugging#/runtime/this-firefox` | Load Temporary Add-on |

dsh-composer-launcher README · Which browsers：Chromium browsers do not allow silent sideloading — that is a browser security rule, not something a plugin can work around (routes A and C above are the two exceptions, and C needs an administrator). So for your everyday browser the plugin's job is to **point precisely**: the Tabs row has an *Open the extensions page* button (route `POST /composer-launcher/open-extensions-page`, which picks the first Chromium installed here) and a *Copy the extension path* button, and `install-extension.ps1` does the same from a terminal — it enumerates the browsers actually installed on this machine (on Windows from the `StartMenuInternet` registry keys, on macOS and Linux from the platforms' own locations), prints them, and opens the right extensions page for the one you choose. `-Browser <id>` picks one non-interactively. Nothing in that script contains a drive letter or a user name.

dsh-composer-launcher README · Which browsers：Firefox is offered but flagged differently in the plugin's own browser table: it is not offered to the debug-browser launcher, because that launcher passes Chromium-only flags.

dsh-composer-launcher README · Port：Default `43130`, or whatever `DSH_LAUNCHER_BRIDGE_PORT` holds when it parses as an integer between 1024 and 65535. That override exists so two DSH instances on one machine can each keep their own bridge instead of one stealing the port from the other (this repository's own end-to-end tests use it for exactly that reason). The extension's port is editable in its popup: if you change one, change the other — a mismatch only means the Tabs row reports the extension as offline and falls back to the debug port.

dsh-composer-launcher README · Port：`43129` is recognised as the legacy port and migrated automatically on first read.

dsh-composer-launcher README · HTTP routes：Everything is served under `/composer-launcher` on the host's existing web server. The plugin does not open a second web port (the bridge on 43130 is a separate, tiny loopback socket for the extension).

dsh-composer-launcher README · HTTP routes：| Method | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `POST` | `/tabs` | The extension pushes its tab list. Returns `{ ok, accepted }` — or `{ accepted: 0, ignored: 'empty-push-kept-previous', kept: N }` when an empty push was refused |
| `GET` | `/tabs?port=` | Merged tab list (extension first, CDP second). Returns `{ source, stale, port, sources: { extension, cdp, mixed }, extensionHint, tabs, error }` |
| `GET` | `/stage-extension` | Copy the bundled extension to a stable path and return `{ extensionDir, dir, browsers, note }` — `browsers` is the list of browsers actually installed here |
| `GET` | `/linked-plugins` | Probe partner plugins. Returns `{ linked: [{ id, label, ok, detail }] }` |
| `POST` | `/open-debug-browser` | Start a Chromium instance with a debugging port **and the staged extension attached**; the answer carries `extensionLoaded` (verified over the debugging port, not assumed), plus `healed`/`note` when a clean profile was needed |
| `POST` | `/open-extensions-page` | Open the extensions page of the first Chromium installed on this machine, for the one-time manual load. Returns `{ ok, browser, url }` |
| `GET` | `/bundles` | The

dsh-composer-launcher README · HTTP routes：Anything else under the prefix returns 404 `{ ok: false, error: 'not found' }`.

Writes are guarded: a non-`GET`/`HEAD` request is rejected with 403 `cross-site request rejected` unless it comes from no origin at all, from a `chrome-extension://` or `moz-extension://` origin, or from the same host. The favicon proxy is the one route that accepts an arbitrary URL, which is exactly why it is sandboxed and byte-sniffed rather than trusted.

---
dsh-composer-launcher README · Interface language：Plugin-owned interface text follows the **host's language**, not a setting of its own.

dsh-composer-launcher README · Interface language：- The client half injects the `locale` service, reads the active locale, and retranslates when it changes — live, without a reload.
- Two tables ship today: **zh** and **en**, 194 keys each, flat and dot-namespaced (`'button.title'`, `'settings.title'`, `'jump.composer.missing'`).
- Lookup order is **active language → en → the key itself**. `t()` can never return `undefined` and can never throw — a missing translation degrades to English, and a missing key degrades to a visible key name rather than a blank row.
- If the locale service is unreachable, the language falls back to `document.documentElement.lang`, then `navigator.language`, then `en`.
- The registry is extensible: `registerLanguage(id, table)` adds a table, and the plugin announces the languages it has to the host's locale service so they can appear in its language picker.
- The **extension** cannot use the host's locale service (it is a separate browser process), so it uses the browser's own `_locales` mechanism with `en` and `zh_CN`, and reads `api.i18n.getUILanguage()`.

dsh-composer-launcher README · With `dsh-capability-composer` — a real, two-way link：This is the one integration that changes what you see, so it is worth being precise about it.

**What the launcher does.** It declares one linked plugin:

```
{ id: 'capability-composer', label: '能力组合器', path: '/dsh-capability-composer/state' }
```

At startup it probes that path and logs `connected` or `absent` per plugin. In the client half it then uses the composer's own endpoints:

dsh-composer-launcher README · With `dsh-capability-composer` — a real, two-way link：| Uses | Endpoint | If the composer is missing |
|---|---|---|
| The plugin rows' narrowing scope | `/dsh-capability-composer/effective?sessionId=…` | Falls back to listing **all** plugins and shows why |
| The settings-jump buttons | `/dsh-capability-composer/state` | Buttons do not jump; a dismissible banner names the missing plugin |

dsh-composer-launcher README · With `dsh-capability-composer` — a real, two-way link：**What happens when the composer is absent.** Nothing breaks. The Common plugins group lists every installed plugin instead of the narrowed set, and the two **Set composition**（「设置组合」）buttons refuse to jump — clicking one shows, for 15 seconds:

> dsh-capability-composer is not installed — install and enable it, then come back and hit Set composition.

dsh-composer-launcher README · With `dsh-capability-composer` — a real, two-way link：**The probe is deliberately optimistic.** A rejected or non-2xx response means "not installed", but a network-level failure (the sandbox transport throwing) is treated as **reachable**. A false "not installed" would be worse than a false "installed": the first hides a working button, the second only means the jump lands on a settings page that is missing its tab.

dsh-composer-launcher README · With `dsh-capability-composer` — a real, two-way link：**What the launcher does not do.** It does not compute the narrowing numbers. The "N / M plugins installed" counter is rendered here, but its two numbers come from the composer (`N`) and from this plugin's own plugin inventory (`M`). And the launcher never writes composer state.

dsh-composer-launcher README · With the MCP panel — an entry point, not a dependency：The **MCP** row in the Capabilities group is fed by the host's `remote.mcpManager` service (in practice, provided by an MCP manager plugin). This plugin's host half contains **no MCP code at all**; it does not read, configure or restart MCP servers.

If that service is absent, the MCP row is simply unavailable, and clicking it returns a plain reason rather than failing silently. Which servers exist, whether they are enabled, and what tools they expose is entirely the MCP panel's business.

dsh-composer-launcher README · Known limitations (stated plainly)：- **The enable/disable switch is not wired.** Plugin rows show state and link to settings; they do not toggle a plugin on or off.
- **Real tabs need the extension** (or the debug browser). There is no third path — a plugin cannot reach into a browser it is not running inside.
- **The bridge port is `43130` unless `DSH_LAUNCHER_BRIDGE_PORT` overrides it.** The extension's side is editable in its popup.
- **Chromium will not let this plugin install the extension into the browser you already use.** It can start its own browser with the extension attached, and it can point precisely at the manual steps; installing silently into an existing browser requires an enterprise policy and administrator rights, which this repository does not ship.
- **Firefox's MV3 support means a temporary load** in most builds; that is a browser constraint, not a plugin one.
- **The favicon proxy accepts arbitrary URLs.** It is sandboxed, byte-sniffed and size-limited, but it is still the one route worth understanding before you expose a machine.

The browser-extension notice: one dialog, naming the steps：- **Why it cannot install itself**: Chromium has a hard rule — nothing may silently sideload an extension into the browser you use every day. The plugin has already staged the files, but the one "Load unpacked" click has to be yours.
- **Three routes**: **A, zero clicks** — press "Open with the extension loaded" and the plugin starts a separate browser instance with the extension attached; **B, into your everyday browser** (one time only) — press "Open the extensions page" → Developer mode → Load unpacked → pick the folder the dialog prints; **C** follow `tutorial-browser-extension.md`.
- **Detection**: the extension pushes its tab list to the plugin; **a received push means "installed"** and the dialog stops appearing immediately. No push means "not installed". Nothing is guessed.
- **Always available**: the browser group has a "How to install" button that brings this same guide up on demand, even after the extension is installed.

dsh-composer-launcher README · From a local checkout：1. **Backtick gate** (`strip-backticks.mjs`) — the client bundle must contain zero backticks before it is deployed. It runs first because it can rewrite the file: a bundle checked before a rewrite is not the bundle that ships.
2. **Deploy** (`install.mjs`) — copies the shipped files into a new generation, writes the generation's `generation.json` and `desired.json`, then calls the host's own `projectGenerations()` to make it live. It finishes by **importing the host half for real** and checking the profile manifest, so a bundle that cannot load is caught here rather than at your next boot.
3. **Verification** — the profile's `dependencies`, `dsh.profile.bundles` and the generation projection are read back and asserted.
dsh-composer-launcher README · From a local checkout：The script finds Node itself: `PATH` first, then the runtime DSH Desktop ships. **You do not have to install Node.**
dsh-composer-launcher README · Then restart DSH：The plugin's host half and its patch file are read at boot only. Restart DSH once after installing; the client half is then loaded with the app.

dsh-composer-launcher README · FAQ：<details>
<summary>Do I need the browser extension?</summary>

No. The plugin's menu, chips, skills, commands, MCP and plugin rows all work without it. The extension only fills in the **Tabs** row with your real browser's open pages. Without it, that row can still read a debug instance you launch yourself.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Can the plugin install the extension by itself?</summary>

dsh-composer-launcher README · FAQ：Into a browser it starts itself, yes — and that route is verified rather than assumed. Into the browser you already have open, no: Chromium forbids silent sideloading, and that is a security rule rather than a missing feature. What the plugin does instead is make the manual half small — *Open the extensions page* and *Copy the extension path* in the Tabs row, or `install-extension.ps1` in a terminal. A fleet can do it centrally with an `ExtensionSettings` / `ExtensionInstallForcelist` policy and its own signed CRX, which needs an administrator and is not shipped here.

dsh-composer-launcher README · FAQ：</details>

<details>
<summary>Why does the Tabs row say the extension is not installed right after I installed it?</summary>

Two usual reasons, both visible in the extension's popup:

- The popup says *unreachable* — the bridge port does not match. Both sides default to `43130`; if you edited one, edit the other.
- The popup says it pushed, but the row is stale — the host keeps a push for 65 seconds and the heartbeat is once a minute, so give it a moment, or hit **Save and push now**.

dsh-composer-launcher README · FAQ：</details>

<details>
<summary>I click "Set composition" and nothing happens.</summary>

That button jumps into the settings pages owned by `dsh-capability-composer`. If that plugin is not installed, the launcher refuses to jump and tells you so instead. When the two are both installed, the jump is a real click through DSH's own settings navigation — the launcher does not fake a settings route.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Can I reference a file from a plugin row, or only plugins?</summary>

dsh-composer-launcher README · FAQ：The **Add** group handles files and folders (with multi-select and drag-and-drop). The **Common plugins** group is about naming a plugin in the message, not attaching its files.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Will my chips survive a reload?</summary>

dsh-composer-launcher README · FAQ：They are per session and live in the client's memory for that session. A reload of the client rebuilds the rail from the session's own state rather than losing it, but chips are not a durable store — they are an input method, and they become message text the moment you send.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Does this send anything to the network?</summary>

dsh-composer-launcher README · FAQ：No. The bridge is loopback only (`127.0.0.1`), the tab data never leaves your machine, and the favicon proxy fetches favicons through the host's own web server rather than from the page. There is no telemetry.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Why is the port 43130 and not something configurable?</summary>

dsh-composer-launcher README · FAQ：Because the two halves must agree on exactly one number, and one of them (the extension) can already be edited by the user. Making both configurable doubles the ways to get it wrong in exchange for a setting nobody needs to change.

</details>

dsh-composer-launcher README · 这是什么：默认情况下，输入框左边的 `+` 按钮只会打开一个文件选择器。其它任何你想「指给模型看」的东西 —— 你正在浏览的标签页、一段历史对话、一个技能、一台 MCP 服务器、这台机器上装的某个插件 —— 都只能手打，或者用 `@` 引用。

`dsh-composer-launcher` 把这个按钮换成一个**三组菜单**：

| 分组 | 里面有什么 |
|---|---|
| **添加** | 文件与文件夹、历史对话、计划模式、目标模式 |
| **能力** | 斜杠指令、技能、MCP 服务器 |
| **常用插件** | 每个已装插件一行，外加一行「全部插件」 |

你选中的东西**不会被当成文本粘贴进去**，而是落成输入框上方一条栏上的**原生引用芯片** —— 和宿主自己为 `@` 引用渲染的芯片是同一种 —— 只有在你真正发送时，它才变成消息文本。

另有一个**可选的浏览器扩展**（`DSH Tab Bridge`），它把你真实浏览器里的标签页通过一条本机回环 HTTP 桥推进插件，所以「标签页」那一行列的是你**真的开着**的页面，而不是一个临时调试实例。

dsh-composer-launcher README · 1. 加号菜单（三组）：一个 360px 高的面板，挂在 `conversation.input.left` 插槽上。

- **添加** —— *文件与文件夹*（宿主自己的选择器，支持多选与拖拽；宿主没有目录选择器时自动退回 `@` 引用）、*历史对话*（走 `remote.sessionReferenceResolver`，只列对话，不含文件）、*计划*、*目标*。
- **能力** —— *指令*（宿主斜杠指令服务提供什么就列什么）、*技能*（用 `ctx.remote.skills.list({ sessionId })` 实时读取）、*MCP*（需要宿主的 `remote.mcpManager`）。
- **常用插件** —— `ctx.remote.pluginInventory.list()` 返回的每个插件一行。这份清单**每次加载都从宿主重新读**，所以装、卸、停用插件会立刻反映出来，不存在需要同步的缓存。三种模式决定显示哪些行：`pinned` / `frequent` / `mixed`（见[设置项](#设置项)）。

每一行都能在设置卡片里单独关掉。

dsh-composer-launcher README · 2. 引用芯片：选中的东西落在输入框**上方**的一条栏上（`conversation.input.dock`）。一个芯片是 `{ label, kind, icon }` 加一个可选的 `url`，其中 `kind` 只取 `web` / `plugin` / `skill` / `mcp` 之一。点 `×` 删掉它。

有两条特性值得单独说，因为它们在变成特性之前都是 bug：

- **网页芯片一定带着地址。** 一个没有 URL 的页面标题，对读这条消息的人来说毫无用处 —— 所以芯片带着 URL，载荷里也带。
- **会话引用始终是芯片。** 把一个引用写回宿主的纯文本草稿接口，会把它悄悄降级成正文；本插件不这么干，它把引用渲染成芯片，并且绝不让它绕一圈变成文本。

芯片是**按会话隔离**的，两个对话标签页不会共用一条栏。

发送时，每个芯片会被序列化成带短标记的消息文本，这样模型能区分「引用的网页」和「附上的文件」：

dsh-composer-launcher README · 2. 引用芯片：| 芯片种类 | 标记 |
|---|---|
| 网页 | `【参考网页】<标题> — <URL>` |
| 插件 | `【使用插件】<名字>` |
| 技能 | `【技能】<名字>` |
| MCP 服务器 | `【MCP】<名字>` |

> 这些标记是**字面量**，两种界面语言下都是中文。它们是**给模型读的**消息文本，不是界面文案 —— 翻译它们等于改变模型看到的内容。
dsh-composer-launcher README · 3. 设置卡片：注册在 `settings.plugin.item` 插槽上，标题是**启动器**（英文界面下是 *Launcher*）。第一次打开时是折叠的，并且会记住这个选择。十二个字段见[设置项](#设置项)。

dsh-composer-launcher README · 4. 调试浏览器（退路）：「标签页」那一行还可以通过远程调试端口，从一个由它自己拉起的 Chromium 进程里读标签页 —— 那就是**拉起调试浏览器**做的事；并且只要扩展已暂存，同一次调用就会用 `--load-extension` 把它挂上，然后**去调试端口核实真的挂上了**，所以这条路线**完全不需要人工步骤**（见[浏览器扩展](#浏览器扩展)）。它仍然是退路而不是主入口：它只看得到那一个一次性配置目录的实例，永远看不到你已经开着的那个浏览器。

dsh-composer-launcher README · 5. 本机回环桥：宿主半边在 `127.0.0.1:43130` 上持有一条很小的 HTTP 桥（可用 `DSH_LAUNCHER_BRIDGE_PORT` 覆盖），好让扩展把标签页推进来。它只绑回环地址，遇到旧实例占着端口时会主动让位，除此之外不做任何别的事。

dsh-composer-launcher README · 浏览器扩展：没有它插件照样能用 —— 「标签页」行会直接说明扩展没装，并指向那个按钮。装了它，这一行列的就是你**日常那个浏览器**里的标签页。

dsh-composer-launcher README · 三条装载路线：Chromium **不会**允许任何东西把扩展静默塞进你日常用的浏览器里 —— 这是浏览器的安全规则，插件这边没有绕过的办法。所以目标得换个说法：把**剩下的**每一步都变成「自动」或者「一次点击」。

| 路线 | 会发生什么 | 人工步骤 |
|---|---|---|
| **A —— 本插件自己拉起的浏览器** | 插件另起一个 Chromium 进程，用 `--load-extension` 指向暂存好的那份扩展，然后**通过调试端口核实扩展真的挂上了** | 无 |
| **B —— 你日常那个浏览器** | 「标签页」行提供 *打开扩展管理页* 与 *复制扩展路径*，装一次就是「粘贴 + 加载解压缩的扩展」 | 一次性，约 20 秒 |
| **C —— 受管机器** | Chromium 企业策略（`ExtensionSettings` / `ExtensionInstallForcelist`）指向自托管、已签名的 CRX + HTTPS 更新清单 | 需要管理员权限；**本仓库不提供** |

dsh-composer-launcher README · 三条装载路线：**路线 A 是核实过的，不是假设。** 拉起之后，插件会向调试端口要原始目标列表，找的是**本扩展自己的 worker**（`chrome-extension://<id>/background.js`），而不是「有扩展就行」—— 每个 Chromium 自己都带好几个。`--load-extension` 被忽略时 Chromium **不会报任何错**，所以「拉起来了」本身什么也证明不了。

如果没找到本扩展的 worker，插件会用干净 profile `~/.dsh-edge-agent-ext` 重试一次，并在返回里用 `healed` / `note` 说明。这不是多余的防御：**被「不带命令行开关」打开过的 profile，之后可能就不再接受这些开关**，本插件默认的 `~/.dsh-edge-agent` 在某些机器上就是这样。两次都失败时 `extensionLoaded` 会如实返回 `false`，「标签页」行退回用调试端口读标签页 —— 插件绝不会声称自己做了实际没做成的那一步。

dsh-composer-launcher README · 三条装载路线：Firefox 无法这样被拉起：启动器传的是 Chromium 专有开关，所以它是浏览器表里唯一被标成「只能手工」的那个。

路线 B 就是那两个按钮和 `install-extension.ps1` 的用途（见下面「支持哪些浏览器」）—— 两者里都没有任何盘符或用户名。

路线 C 对成建制部署是真实答案，但不在本仓库范围内：它需要管理员权限、你自己签名的 CRX，以及一个提供更新清单的 HTTPS 端点。本仓库一个都不提供，README 也不该假装有。

dsh-composer-launcher README · 它怎么工作：它**不轮询**，是扩展主动**推送**：

| 触发 | 动作 |
|---|---|
| `tabs.onCreated` / `onUpdated` / `onRemoved` / `onActivated` / `onMoved` / `onAttached` / `onDetached` | 立刻推 |
| 一分钟一次的 `alarms` 心跳 | 推 |
| 浏览器启动、安装、更新 | 推 |

每次推送都是 `POST http://127.0.0.1:43130/composer-launcher/tabs`，body 是 `{ tabs: [...] }`。推送失败会被吞掉，绝不抛出 —— 桥是允许关着的，扩展不能因此在控制台里刷错误。

宿主把最后一次推送保留 **65 秒**（`PUSH_TTL_MS`），**刻意比一分钟心跳长**，这样一次慢心跳不会让这一行闪成空的。**空推送会被忽略而不是照做**（返回 `ignored: 'empty-push-kept-previous'`），因为浏览器偶尔报个空列表，绝不能把清单清掉。

dsh-composer-launcher README · 它怎么工作：推送的字段是 `{ id, title, url, host, favIconUrl, browser }`。内部页在发送前就被过滤掉了：`chrome:`、`edge:`、`brave:`、`opera:`、`vivaldi:`、`about:`、`devtools:`、`chrome-extension:`、`extension:`、`moz-extension:`。

扩展的弹窗会显示连接状态、允许你改端口，还有一个**保存并立刻推送**按钮，用于不想等下一次心跳的时候。
dsh-composer-launcher README · 支持哪些浏览器：扩展是 Manifest V3，并且统一走 `globalThis.browser ?? globalThis.chrome`，所以每个 Chromium 浏览器和 Firefox 都能装。

dsh-composer-launcher README · 支持哪些浏览器：| 浏览器 | 扩展页 | 安装方式 |
|---|---|---|
| Microsoft Edge | `edge://extensions` | 加载解压缩的扩展 |
| Google Chrome | `chrome://extensions` | 加载已解压的扩展程序 |
| Brave | `brave://extensions` | Load unpacked |
| Vivaldi | `vivaldi://extensions` | Load unpacked |
| Opera | `opera://extensions` | Load unpacked |
| Arc | `arc://extensions` | Load unpacked |
| 360 极速浏览器 | `chrome://extensions` | 加载已解压的扩展程序 |

dsh-composer-launcher README · 支持哪些浏览器：Chromium 不允许静默旁加载扩展 —— 这是浏览器的安全规则，插件绕不过去（上面的路线 A 和 C 是两个例外，而 C 需要管理员）。所以对日常浏览器，插件能做的是**把路指准**：「标签页」行有 *打开扩展管理页* 按钮（走路由 `POST /composer-launcher/open-extensions-page`，自动挑这台机器上第一个 Chromium）和 *复制扩展路径* 按钮；`install-extension.ps1` 在终端里做同样的事 —— 它枚举**这台机器上真正装了的**浏览器（Windows 上读 `StartMenuInternet` 注册表项，macOS 与 Linux 读各自平台的位置），把它们打出来，然后为你选中的那个打开正确的扩展页。`-Browser <id>` 可以非交互地指定。那个脚本里**没有任何盘符或用户名**。

Firefox 也在支持列表里，但在插件自己的浏览器表里被单独标记：它**不会被提供给调试浏览器启动器**，因为那个启动器传的是 Chromium 专有的参数。

dsh-composer-launcher README · 端口：默认 `43130`；若环境变量 `DSH_LAUNCHER_BRIDGE_PORT` 能解析成 1024–65535 的整数，则用它的值。这个覆盖开关是为了让一台机器上跑两个 DSH 实例时各留一条自己的桥，而不是互相把端口抢走（本仓库自己的端到端测试正是用它做到这一点的）。扩展那半边的端口可以在弹窗里改：改了一边就要改另一边 —— 不一致的唯一后果是「标签页」行报告扩展离线，并退回调试端口那条路。

`43129` 被识别为旧端口，第一次读到时会自动迁移。

dsh-composer-launcher README · HTTP 路由：| 方法 | 路径 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `POST` | `/tabs` | 扩展推送标签页。返回 `{ ok, accepted }`；空推送被拒时返回 `{ accepted: 0, ignored: 'empty-push-kept-previous', kept: N }` |
| `GET` | `/tabs?port=` | 合并后的标签页（扩展优先，CDP 次之）。返回 `{ source, stale, port, sources: { extension, cdp, mixed }, extensionHint, tabs, error }` |
| `GET` | `/stage-extension` | 把随包的扩展拷到一个稳定路径，返回 `{ extensionDir, dir, browsers, note }` —— `browsers` 就是这台机器上真正装了的浏览器列表 |
| `GET` | `/linked-plugins` | 探测伙伴插件。返回 `{ linked: [{ id, label, ok, detail }] }` |
| `POST` | `/open-debug-browser` | 起一个带调试端口、**并且已挂上暂存扩展**的 Chromium 实例；返回里的 `extensionLoaded` 是**去调试端口核实过的**（不是假设），需要换干净 profile 时另有 `healed` / `note` |
| `POST` | `/open-extensions-page` | 打开这台机器上第一个 Chromium 的扩展页，用于那一次手工装载。返回 `{ ok, browser, url }` |
| `GET` | `/bundles` | profile 挂载的插件清单 |
| `GET`\|`HEAD` | `/favicon?u=<编码后>` | 同源 favicon 代理：嗅探字节、缓存 6 小时、响应头带 `default-src 'none'; sandbox` |
| `GET`\|`HEAD` | `/bridge` | 桥的身份：`{ bridge: true, pid, port, holding, startedAt }` |
| `POST` | `/bridge-yield` | 请旧实例让出桥端口 |
| `GET` | `/health` | `{ plugin, extensionTabs, extensionAt }` |

dsh-composer-launcher README · HTTP 路由：该前缀下其它任何路径返回 404 `{ ok: false, error: 'not found' }`。

写操作是有闸的：非 `GET`/`HEAD` 的请求，如果不是「完全没有 Origin」、不是 `chrome-extension://` 或 `moz-extension://` 来源、也不是同 Host，一律 403 `cross-site request rejected`。favicon 代理是唯一一条接受任意 URL 的路由 —— 正因如此它被沙箱化并做了字节嗅探，而不是被信任。

dsh-composer-launcher README · 界面语言：- 客户端半边注入 `locale` 服务、读当前语言，并在它变化时**实时重译**，不用刷新。
- 目前随包两份表：**中文**与**英文**，各 194 条，扁平点分命名（`'button.title'`、`'settings.title'`、`'jump.composer.missing'`）。
- 取词顺序是**当前语言 → 英文 → 键名本身**。`t()` 永远不可能返回 `undefined`，也永远不会抛错 —— 缺一条翻译就降级到英文，连键都没有就显示键名，而不是留一行空白。
- 拿不到 locale 服务时，语言依次退回 `document.documentElement.lang` → `navigator.language` → `en`。
- 注册表是**可扩展的**：`registerLanguage(id, table)` 加一份表，插件还会把自己已有的语言通报给宿主 locale 服务，好让它们出现在宿主的语言选择里。
- **扩展**用不了宿主的 locale 服务（它是另一个浏览器进程），所以它走浏览器自己的 `_locales` 机制，带 `en` 与 `zh_CN` 两份，并读 `api.i18n.getUILanguage()`。

dsh-composer-launcher README · 与 `dsh-capability-composer` —— 一条真实、双向的联动：> **这是唯一一条会改变你看到什么的联动，所以必须说清楚。**

**启动器做了什么。** 它声明了一个联动插件：

```
{ id: 'capability-composer', label: '能力组合器', path: '/dsh-capability-composer/state' }
```

启动时它探一下那个路径，逐个打印 `connected` 或 `absent`。在客户端半边，它使用组合器自己的接口：

| 用途 | 接口 | 组合器不在时 |
|---|---|---|
| 插件行的收窄范围 | `/dsh-capability-composer/effective?sessionId=…` | 退回**列出全部**插件，并说明为什么 |
| 「设置组合」跳转按钮 | `/dsh-capability-composer/state` | 不跳转，并显示一条可关闭的提示，点名缺失的插件 |

**组合器不在时会发生什么。** 什么都不会坏。「常用插件」组列出所有已装插件，而不是被收窄过的那一撮；两个**设置组合**按钮拒绝跳转，点击后显示 15 秒：

dsh-composer-launcher README · 与 `dsh-capability-composer` —— 一条真实、双向的联动：> 未检测到组合器插件 dsh-capability-composer —— 请先安装并启用它，再回来点「设置组合」。

**探测是刻意偏乐观的。** 被拒绝或非 2xx 的响应会被判为「没装」，但**网络层抛错会被当成「可达」**。一个假的「没装」比一个假的「装了」更糟：前者把一个能用的按钮藏起来，后者只是让跳转落到一个暂时没有那个页签的设置页上。

**启动器不做什么。** 它**不计算**收窄数字。「N / M 已装插件」这个计数是在这里渲染的，但两个数字分别来自组合器（`N`）和本插件的插件清单（`M`）。启动器**从不写**组合器的状态。

dsh-composer-launcher README · 已知边界（如实说明）：- **启用 / 禁用开关没有接。** 插件行会显示状态并链到设置页，但不会从这里开关一个插件。
- **真标签页只能靠扩展**（或调试浏览器）。没有第三条路 —— 插件没法伸手进一个自己不在其中运行的浏览器。
- **桥端口是 `43130`，除非 `DSH_LAUNCHER_BRIDGE_PORT` 覆盖它。** 扩展那半边可以在弹窗里改。
- **Chromium 不允许本插件把扩展装进你已经开着的那个浏览器里。** 它能自己拉起一个浏览器并把扩展挂上，也能把手工步骤指得很准；要静默装进现有浏览器，需要企业策略与管理员权限，本仓库不提供。
- **Firefox 的 MV3 支持在多数构建里意味着临时载入**，这是浏览器限制，不是插件的。
- **favicon 代理接受任意 URL。** 它被沙箱化、做了字节嗅探与体积限制，但它仍然是唯一一条在把机器暴露出去之前值得先搞明白的路由。

dsh-composer-launcher README · 9. 浏览器扩展提醒：装好就弹一次，指到怎么装：浏览器扩展只属于本插件（加号启动器），所以这个弹窗也只由本插件弹。装好插件后第一次打开界面会弹一次，写清楚：

- **为什么不能自动装**：Chromium 有一条硬规则 —— 任何东西都不允许静默把扩展塞进你日常用的浏览器。扩展文件插件已经放到位，但「加载解压缩的扩展」那一下必须你自己点。
- **三条路**：**A 零人工** —— 点「用带扩展的浏览器打开」，插件另起一个浏览器实例并把扩展挂好；**B 装进日常浏览器**（只需一次）—— 点「打开扩展管理页」→ 开发者模式 → 加载解压缩的扩展 → 选弹窗里印出来的那个目录；**C** 图文步骤见 `tutorial-browser-extension.zh-CN.md`。
- **检测系统**：扩展会主动把标签页推给插件，**收到过推送即判定「已装」**，弹窗立刻不再出现；没收到就是「没装」。这里不猜。
- **随时可看**：浏览器分组里有一个「安装说明」按钮，任何时候点它都能把这份步骤调出来（即使已经装好）。

**本插件不需要给 DSH 打任何补丁** —— 补丁归需要补丁的插件去提醒，扩展归这里，两者互不代言。

node install.mjs

dsh-composer-launcher README · 从本地目录：1. **反引号闸门**（`strip-backticks.mjs`）—— 客户端 bundle 在部署前必须一个反引号都没有。它排在第一位是因为它会改文件：改之前检查过的 bundle，不等于最后发出去的那个 bundle。
2. **部署**（`install.mjs`）—— 把发货清单里的文件拷进一个新的 generation，写这个 generation 的 `generation.json` 与 `desired.json`，然后调宿主自己的 `projectGenerations()` 让它生效。它最后会**真的 import 一次宿主半边**并回读 profile 清单，所以一个装不起来的 bundle 会在这里就被抓到，而不是等你下次开机。
3. **复核** —— 回读 profile 的 `dependencies`、`dsh.profile.bundles` 与 generation 投影并断言。

脚本自己找 Node：先看 `PATH`，再看 DSH Desktop 自带的运行时。**你不需要自己装 Node。**

要在你日常用的浏览器里用，只需装一次：

它会把扩展放到一个稳定路径，列出它在这台机器上找到的浏览器，并打开对应的扩展页。加 `-Browser edge`（或 `chrome`、`brave`、`vivaldi`、`opera`、`arc`、`360`、`qq`、`firefox`）可以跳过选择。「标签页」行上的 *打开扩展管理页* 与 *复制扩展路径* 两个按钮不用终端就能做掉前半截；完整走法（包括 Chromium 允许什么、不允许什么）都在[浏览器扩展](#浏览器扩展)一章里。

dsh-composer-launcher README · 常见问题：<details>
<summary>我需要装那个浏览器扩展吗？</summary>

不需要。插件的菜单、芯片、技能、指令、MCP 和插件行，不用扩展全都能用。扩展只负责把**标签页**那一行填成你真实浏览器里开着的页面。没有它，那一行仍然可以读你自己拉起来的调试实例。

</details>

<details>
<summary>插件能自己把扩展装上吗？</summary>

装进**它自己拉起的**浏览器里，可以 —— 而且那条路线是核实过的，不是假设。装进**你已经开着的**浏览器里，不行：Chromium 禁止静默旁加载，这是安全规则，不是功能缺失。插件能做的是把手工那半截缩到最小 —— 「标签页」行上的 *打开扩展管理页* 与 *复制扩展路径*，或者在终端里跑 `install-extension.ps1`。成建制部署可以用 `ExtensionSettings` / `ExtensionInstallForcelist` 策略加自己的已签名 CRX，但那需要管理员，且本仓库不提供。

</details>

dsh-composer-launcher README · 常见问题：<details>
<summary>我刚装了扩展，「标签页」行却说没装？</summary>

两个常见原因，扩展的弹窗里都看得到：

- 弹窗显示*连不上* —— 端口对不上。两边默认都是 `43130`；你改了一边，就把另一边也改了。
- 弹窗说推过了，但那一行还是旧的 —— 宿主把一次推送保留 65 秒，心跳是一分钟一次，稍等一下，或者点**保存并立刻推送**。

</details>

<details>
<summary>我点「设置组合」没反应。</summary>

那个按钮是往 `dsh-capability-composer` 拥有的设置页里跳。那个插件没装时，启动器**拒绝跳转**并告诉你原因。两个都装了的时候，这个跳转是**真的去点** DSH 自己的设置导航 —— 启动器不会伪造一条设置路由。

</details>

<details>
<summary>「添加」组和「常用插件」组有什么区别？</summary>

**添加**组管的是文件与文件夹（支持多选与拖拽）。**常用插件**组是在消息里**点名一个插件**，不是附加它的文件。

</details>

dsh-composer-launcher README · 常见问题：<details>
<summary>芯片在重新加载后还在吗？</summary>

芯片是按会话的，活在客户端为那个会话保留的内存里。客户端重载时，那条栏会从会话自己的状态重建，而不是丢掉；但芯片不是持久存储 —— 它是一种输入方式，你一发送它就变成了消息文本。

</details>

<details>
<summary>这个插件会往网上发东西吗？</summary>

不会。桥只绑回环（`127.0.0.1`），标签页数据不离开你的机器，favicon 代理也是通过宿主自己的 web 服务器去取，而不是从页面里取。没有任何遥测。

</details>

<details>
<summary>为什么端口是 43130，不做成可配置的？</summary>

因为两半必须对**同一个**数字达成一致，而其中一半（扩展）本来就已经允许用户改了。把两边都做成可配置，只会让「配错」的路径翻倍，换来一个人人都不需要改的设置项。

</details>

dsh-composer-launcher README · 自检：在一个干净的检出上可以跑两项检查，都是离线、且除非注明否则只读：

```bash
node verify.mjs
```

布局（清单里 `dsh.bundle.patch` 指向的文件真的存在）、清单字段、对每个源文件做 `node --check`、扫描密钥与残留备份文件、以及硬编码机器路径扫描。它打印 `VERIFY PASSED` 或 `VERIFY FAILED`，失败时退出码非零。

```bash
node bridge-selfcheck.mjs
```

它会**真的起两个 Node 进程**，证明桥在跨进程时的行为 —— 包括第二个实例会主动让位而不是抢端口。**请在 `install.ps1` 之后跑**，因为它需要已部署的插件。
